title: Treatise on the Long Lunge
summary: Teaches the deep and running lunge that carries the point far beyond the usual reach to students of the Champion stage.

title: The Counter-Time Canon
summary: A canon on thrusting into the very instant the foe begins his own attack so his motion becomes the wound.

title: Qi Point Extension Canon
summary: Shows a Xiantian student how to spread the living field of qi along the blade and thrust beyond the steel.

title: Rules of the Unbroken Line
summary: Sets out the rules for keeping one unbroken line of thrust and guard toward the foe through a long duel.

title: The Paired Parry Rolls of the Azure Fencers
summary: Records the dual-track rapier of the Azure Sky in which every parry carries its own answering thrust.

title: Hawk-Stoop Lunge Method of the Basin
summary: Teaches the stooping lunge of the hawk style from a high guard down onto the foe in one long fall.

title: Twin-Track Point Treatise
summary: A treatise on running two tracks of point and field together so one thrust threatens two lines at once.

title: River-Basin Riposte Cycle
summary: Describes a cycle of parry and riposte that turns like a river through its basin and never rests.

title: Oath of the Narrow Bearing
summary: Teaches a Champion to take a bearing on the foe and hold it with the point as a sworn line.

title: Crosswind Disengage Notes
summary: Notes on the slipping point that veers like a crosswind and finds the open line as the foe commits.

title: The Wind-Sworn Point Rolls
summary: Records the rapier of the wind-sworn masters who thrust with the whole gale of the field behind the point.

title: Bearing and Gale-Step Treatise
summary: A treatise on fixing a bearing and crossing the ground to it in gale-quick steps with the point leading.
